# redis-valkey

Command danger classes (KEYS, FLUSHALL, blocking SAVE), TTL policy and keyspace hygiene the data-access adapter measures.

## Recipes

- `apiforge model redis --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge knowledge show redis-valkey`
- `apiforge judge` then filter findings by rules AF-DATA-001, AF-DATA-002, AF-DATA-003, AF-DATA-004, AF-DATA-005, AF-DATA-006, AF-DATA-007, AF-DATA-008
